Previously proved exact middle-index identities determine the complete vector. 65-digit quadrature and standalone Python checker provide independent numerical consistency, not proof.

value.rationale: The precisely motivated n=4 iid Gaussian differential-equation stability-index law was published with only Monte-Carlo endpoint probability. The new exact one-dimensional elementary integral is a meaningful natural invariant, solves an explicit gap in the same distribution, enables arbitrary-precision computational benchmarking, and is not merely a restatement of the already known linear distributional constraints. No grand asymptotic theorem is claimed.
